name: 0CodeKit
desc: Ready-made utilities for automations: dates and calendar weeks, conversions, validation, PDF and QR tools, file storage, AI text and image analysis, code execution, crypto and short links.

actions.name: current_month
actions.description: Get the days, workdays, Saturdays and Sundays of the current month.

actions.name: specific_month_and_year
actions.description: Get the days, workdays, Saturdays and Sundays of a chosen month.

actions.name: current_week
actions.description: Get the calendar week number and the first and last day of the current week.

actions.name: current_week_from_date
actions.description: Get the calendar week number and the first and last day of the week a date falls in.

actions.name: current_week_from_unix_timestamp
actions.description: Get the calendar week number and the first and last day of the week a Unix timestamp falls in.

actions.name: current_week_with_week_number
actions.displayName: Current Week only with Week Number
actions.description: Get the first and last day of a calendar week in the current year.

actions.name: current_week_with_week_number_and_year
actions.displayName: Current Week with Week Number and Year
actions.description: Get the first and last day of a calendar week in a chosen year.

actions.name: is_weekend
actions.description: Check whether a date falls on a Saturday or Sunday, and get its weekday.

actions.name: is_weekend_with_format
actions.displayName: Is Given Date is Weekend, with Format
actions.description: Check whether a date written in a custom format falls on a weekend, and get its weekday.

actions.name: get_holidays
actions.displayName: Holidays in Specific Country and Year
actions.description: List the public holidays of a country, and optionally a state, for a year.

actions.name: convert_timezone_with_date
actions.description: Convert a date and time from one time zone to another.

actions.name: convert_timezone_with_unix_timestamp
actions.displayName: Convert Between Timezones with Unix Timestamp
actions.description: Show a Unix timestamp as a date and time in another time zone.

actions.name: convert_csv_to_json
actions.description: Turn CSV text into a list of rows you can loop over.

actions.name: convert_currency
actions.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at the latest exchange rate.

actions.name: convert_ip_to_geo
actions.description: Look up the country, city, coordinates and provider of an IP address.

actions.name: convert_iso_to_nation
actions.description: Get the English country name for an ISO country code.

actions.name: convert_nation_to_iso
actions.description: Get the ISO country code for an English country name.

actions.name: calculate_bmi
actions.description: Calculate body mass index, desirable weight and daily nutrient needs from height and weight.

actions.name: calculate_geo_distance
actions.description: Get the travel distance and time between two addresses.

actions.name: validate_bic
actions.description: Check whether a BIC (SWIFT code) is valid.

actions.name: validate_email
actions.displayName: Validates an email and correct it
actions.description: Check whether an email address is valid and get a corrected version of it.

actions.name: validate_iban
actions.description: Check whether an IBAN bank account number is valid.

actions.name: validate_vat_with_country_code
actions.displayName: Validate vat with Countrycode and plain ID
actions.description: Check an EU VAT number against VIES, with the country and the number given separately.

actions.name: validate_vat_id
actions.displayName: Checks validity of a VAT ID
actions.description: Check a full EU VAT ID, including its country prefix, against VIES.

actions.name: lookup_vat_rates
actions.description: Get the standard and reduced VAT rates of an EU country.

actions.name: verify_domain
actions.description: Check whether a domain or website is reachable and get its main domain.

actions.name: detect_gender
actions.description: Guess whether a first name is male, female or unisex.

actions.name: split_name
actions.description: Split a full name into first name and last name.

actions.name: text_contains
actions.description: Check whether a text contains one or more keywords, and where.

actions.name: get_random_city
actions.description: Generate a random, fictional city and country name for test data.

actions.name: get_random_name
actions.description: Generate a random person name for test data.

actions.name: get_random_name_with_gender
actions.description: Generate a random male or female person name for test data.

actions.name: get_a_number
actions.description: Generate a random number between a minimum and a maximum.

actions.name: get_pdf_page_count
actions.description: Count the pages in a PDF file.

actions.name: create_pdf_from_html
actions.description: Render HTML markup into a PDF file.

actions.name: create_pdf_from_url
actions.displayName: Creates a PDF file from URL
actions.description: Capture a web page as a PDF file.

actions.name: merge_pdfs
actions.description: Combine several PDF files into one, in the order you list them.

actions.name: split_pdf
actions.description: Break a PDF into several smaller PDF files.

actions.name: generate_qr_code
actions.description: Create a QR code image (PNG) from text or a link.

actions.name: decode_qr_code
actions.description: Read the text or link stored in a QR code image.

actions.name: image_exif
actions.description: Read the EXIF details of a photo, such as camera, date taken and GPS location.

actions.name: add_temporary_file
actions.displayName: Add a Temporary File and Recieve a URL
actions.description: Upload a file and get a public download link that expires after 24 hours.

actions.name: add_a_global_variable
actions.description: Save a value in 0CodeKit so any of your flows can read it later.

actions.name: get_a_global_variable
actions.description: Read the value of a global variable saved in 0CodeKit.

actions.name: delete_a_global_variable
actions.description: Permanently remove a global variable from 0CodeKit.

actions.name: list_global_variables
actions.description: Get every global variable saved in your 0CodeKit account.

actions.name: add_a_perm_file
actions.description: Upload a file to 0CodeKit permanent storage and get a lasting download link.

actions.name: get_a_perm_file
actions.description: Get a file from 0CodeKit permanent storage so later steps can use it.

actions.name: delete_a_perm_file
actions.description: Permanently remove a file from 0CodeKit permanent storage.

actions.name: list_perm_files
actions.description: Get every file in your 0CodeKit permanent storage and how much space is left.

actions.name: entity_detection
actions.description: Find people, places, organizations, dates and other named entities in a text.

actions.name: language_detection
actions.description: Detect which language a text is written in.

actions.name: mood_detection
actions.description: Analyze whether a text sounds positive, neutral or negative.

actions.name: picture_object_recognition
actions.description: List the objects and things that appear in an image.

actions.name: picture_text_recognition
actions.description: Read the text shown in an image (OCR).

actions.name: translate_text
actions.description: Translate a text into another language.

actions.name: run_javascript_code
actions.description: Run JavaScript in a 0CodeKit sandbox (Bun runtime); what it returns is under Result. Each run costs 50 credits and is limited to 180 seconds.

actions.name: run_python_code
actions.description: Run Python in a 0CodeKit sandbox; the value of `result` is under Result. Each run costs 50 credits (the free plan includes 250 credits a month) and is limited to 180 seconds.

actions.name: crypto_decrypt
actions.description: Decrypt text that was encrypted with a secret key using AES, DES, Triple DES, Rabbit or RC4.

actions.name: crypto_encrypt
actions.description: Encrypt text with a secret key using AES, DES, Triple DES, Rabbit or RC4.

actions.name: crypto_hash
actions.description: Create a hash (MD5, SHA, RIPEMD) or an HMAC signature of a text.

actions.name: create_a_scheduler
actions.description: Have 0CodeKit call a webhook with your data once, at set times, on a cron schedule, or every n hours, days, weeks or months.

actions.name: delete_a_scheduler
actions.description: Stop a 0CodeKit scheduler so it no longer calls its webhook.

actions.name: list_schedulers
actions.description: Get every active scheduler in your 0CodeKit account.

actions.name: advanced_switch_with_url
actions.description: Look up values by key in a JSON file hosted at a URL.

actions.name: create_custom_shortened_url
actions.description: Create a short lyl.ai link with your own ending that redirects to a URL.

actions.name: create_shortened_url
actions.description: Create a short lyl.ai link that redirects to a URL.

actions.name: delete_shortened_url
actions.description: Permanently remove a short link so it stops redirecting.

actions.name: get_a_shortened_url
actions.description: Find out where one of your short links redirects to.

actions.name: list_shortened_urls
actions.description: Get every short link created with your 0CodeKit account.

actions.name: update_shortened_url
actions.description: Change where one of your short links redirects to.

actions.name: url_expander
actions.description: Find the full URL behind a short link from any URL shortener.

actions.name: utm_build
actions.description: Add UTM tracking parameters to a URL.

actions.name: utm_parse
actions.description: Read the UTM tracking parameters from a URL.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
